item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena's school in Pune sets up a small fish pond on the campus. The students must manage the pond so that it supports ecosystem health, not just fish production.
Which practice would best support the health of this human-made ecosystem in the long term?

options.A: Adding extra chemical fertiliser to the pond every week so the fish grow as fast as possible
options.B: Growing water plants around the pond, limiting fish numbers, and using kitchen-waste compost in moderate amounts
options.C: Removing all the pond plants so that more sunlight reaches the water for the fish
options.D: Releasing a new fast-breeding foreign fish species to increase the fish yield quickly
